Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Stage II Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Navy has released the Stage II Admit Card for the post of Navy Agniveer SSR | MR 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch. Applications for the Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 March 2026 to 06 April 2026. Candidates who qualified for this stage I examination can download their Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Stage II Admit Card 2026 which has given below.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
